title: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF AN IOT-BASED MULTISENSOR MONITORING SYSTEM FOR MONITORING TEMPERATURE, HUMIDITY, PH, AND TDS PARAMETERS IN THE AGRICULTURE INDUSTRY
description: This system is designed to support precision agriculture by monitoring environmental conditions in real-time using temperature, humidity, pH, and TDS sensors. The data from the sensors is processed using an IoT-based microcontroller and sent to a monitoring platform so it can be accessed remotely.

title: Design and Build a Firefighting Robot Using Bluetooth and Virtual Reality Control
description: This project develops a firefighting robot that can be controlled using Bluetooth technology and a Virtual Reality (VR) interface. This system allows the operator to control the robot immersively to detect and extinguish fires in dangerous areas without direct contact.

title: Automatic Fire Extinguisher With With Assembler Language
description: This system is an automatic fire extinguisher device based on an embedded system, programmed using Assembly language to provide low-level control. The system is designed to detect fire conditions and automatically activate the extinguishing mechanism.

title: Implementation of a Temperature Control System in an Automatic Egg Incubator Based on Arduino with Temperature Monitoring and Setpoint via GUI
description: This project implements an Arduino-based automatic egg incubator system equipped with temperature control and monitoring through a GUI interface. Users can set the temperature setpoint and monitor the incubation conditions in real-time.

title: Motor RPM Measurement Control System Using IR Speed Sensor and Arduino
description: This project develops a motor rotation speed (RPM) measurement system using an infrared (IR) sensor and an Arduino microcontroller. The system can read rotation changes in real-time and convert them into accurate RPM values.
